title: Dashboard + calendar: real data only, working controls, readable calendar
goal: The dashboard shows only real, consistent numbers with working Quick Add and date range; the calendar month view is clean in light and dark.
context: Before editing, read desktop/audit/fix/FIX-PLAN.md sections 3 (executor rules), 4 (worktree bootstrap + runtime stack) and 5 (gates), and desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md. Bug details (symptom, repro, evidence) for every id below are in desktop/audit/fix/bugs.json and BUGS.md. Verified (dashboard/page.tsx): trend % 12/5/8/5 and "87% Collection Rate" are constants (746-767); sparkData literals (807-843); Quick Add has no onClick (784); dateRange state unused (682-683); "Revenue (Month) Rs0" from won leads contradicts "Revenue This Month Rs221.3Cr" from invoices; fetches leads?limit=1000 and invoices?limit=1000 to compute client-side (705-708) (BUG-046 dashboard part). The reports hub uses a dashboard KPI API ("renders KPI metrics from the dashboard API" in reports.spec.ts) - find it in src/lib/api/reports.ts and reuse it (read-only). calendar/page.tsx: out-of-month cells drawn with orange highlight borders; event chips 10px text at 2.8:1; dark "Republic Day"-style low contrast; 51 lint errors (39 raw px/hex). components/domain/sticky-notes-widget.tsx and components/domain/dashboard/sticky-notes-widget.tsx are duplicates. W6 RULES: you run in parallel with 11 other page batches in separate worktrees - touch ONLY your allowlist; never edit lint-baseline.json (the orchestrator ratchets it after merge); shared-file needs go to desktop/audit/fix/requests/<BATCH_ID>.md.
steps: Dashboard KPIs from the dashboard/reports API: one revenue definition (invoiced this month) labelled clearly; show trend deltas only when the API returns a previous-period value, otherwise omit the trend chip; collection rate computed from API paid/total or omitted; sparklines only from API series, else removed. No hard-coded numbers.
Quick Add -> DropdownMenu: New lead (/leads/new), New contact (/contacts/new), New task (/tasks?new=1 or its dialog route), New invoice (/invoices/new), New itinerary (/itineraries/new).
Date range selector drives the KPI queries (date_preset param) - or remove it if the API cannot filter; never a dead control.
Replace the limit=1000 fetches with server aggregates or small lists (recent 5) (BUG-046 dashboard part).

Calendar: out-of-month days muted (text-ds-foreground-subtle, no border highlight), today ring = ds-ring, event chips text-xs with ds tone pairs (subtle bg + on-subtle text, >= 4.5:1) in both themes; DatePicker/toLocalDateString for any date inputs.
Keep one sticky-notes widget (components/domain/dashboard/sticky-notes-widget.tsx) and update imports; delete the duplicate.

CONTRACT SWEEP on every non-spec file in your allowlist (do this while fixing the bugs above, file by file): (a) `node scripts/lint-gate.mjs --zero <your allowlist globs>` must report 0 errors in your files: replace `any` with real types imported from desktop/src/lib/api/*, delete unused vars/imports, remove raw hex/rgb/px literals and raw Tailwind palette classes. Token map: gray/slate text -> text-ds-foreground / text-ds-foreground-muted / text-ds-foreground-subtle; gray backgrounds -> bg-ds-surface / bg-ds-surface-sunken / bg-ds-surface-raised; borders -> border-ds-border / border-ds-border-strong; green/emerald -> ds-success (+ -subtle bg, -on-subtle text); red/rose -> ds-danger; amber/yellow/orange -> ds-warning; blue/sky/cyan -> ds-info; indigo/violet/purple/orange-as-brand/primary-NNN -> ds-primary; chart colours -> ds-chart-1..6 or useThemeTokens(); arbitrary px (text-[13px], w-[240px], h-[600px]) -> Tailwind scale (text-sm, w-60) or ds spacing (p-ds-4, gap-ds-2).

LAYOUT: every page root uses an archetype (ListPage / EntityForm / DetailPage) or `<PageContainer>` from @/components/layout/page-container with a PageHeader (title + description + actions). Remove ad-hoc root padding (p-6, px-8, container mx-auto) and any page-level scroll wrapper (`h-full overflow-auto`, `flex-1 overflow-y-auto`) - <main> is the only page scroller; tables scroll inside DataTable's data-scroll-region (BUG-048 contribution).

FIELDS: native `<input type="date">` -> DatePicker (+ toLocalDateString / parseLocalDate from @/lib/dates); money `type="number"` inputs -> CurrencyInput; any id/relation text input -> RelationCombobox (with resolveSelected for edit forms); phone -> PhoneInput; `window.confirm` / bare `confirm(` -> `useConfirm()` from @/components/ui; `toLocaleDateString()` / `toLocaleString()` without a locale -> formatDisplayDate from @/lib/dates (en-IN); no mailto:/wa.me/tel: (SendMessageDialog). Icon-only buttons get an aria-label. Never two elements with the same id on one page.

PROBE: with your stack slot up, run `node scripts/layout-probe.mjs --routes /dashboard,/calendar --viewports 1366x768,1920x1080 --themes light,dark --out audit/fix/probe/<BATCH_ID>` (replace <id> placeholders with real seeded ids from the API) and fix every failure (gutter, horizontal overflow, nested scroller, console/page error, blank top-bar title). Attach probe.json summary to your report.

SPECS: run the specs listed in gates.specs; fix app regressions. If a spec asserts behaviour this batch intentionally changed, update that spec (spec files in your allowlist only). Pre-existing failures that belong to another batch: list them in your report, do not chase them.

If you need a change in a shared file you may not touch (ui primitives, archetypes, client, globals, helpers), do NOT edit it: write the request to desktop/audit/fix/requests/<BATCH_ID>.md (file per batch, so parallel merges never conflict) and work around locally where possible. B30 consumes these requests.
mustNotTouch: any file owned by another W6 batch (see FIX-PLAN.md section 6 ownership table)
acceptance: No literal trend/collection/sparkline numbers remain in dashboard/page.tsx (grep for 87 / sparkData).
Quick Add opens a menu whose items navigate.
Network tab on /dashboard: no request with limit=1000.
Calendar leading/trailing days are not highlighted (screenshot).
Probe clean on /dashboard and /calendar (both viewports, both themes).
lint-gate --zero passes for the owned globs.
notes: ai-health-score/ai-recommendations may be used on contact/lead detail pages - keep their props stable.
